# Card art: the cards still missing a picture (generated by `pnpm cardprompts:missing`: do not edit by hand)

169 cards: 163 with no picture, 6 showing a borrowed copy of another card's picture. Nine to a sheet, best cards first in each character.

## How to use
1. Start with [missing-batch-01.md](missing-batch-01.md) (the first sheet of every character: their best cards). Paste ONE prompt at a time into the image AI and attach the Valeria image (`Sunlit Paladin with Shield and Sword.png`) as the style anchor.
2. Check that the pictures are separate, in a clean 3 x 3 grid, with no text. If a picture is wrong, regenerate the whole sheet (I cut by position).
3. Each prompt ends by asking ChatGPT to save the picture as a PNG with the right name (for example `knight-m01.png`) and give a download link: download it into `assets-src/cards/`. If it hands back a plain image instead, save it under the name in the sheet heading.
4. Tell me which sheets are in: I cut them (`tools/pack-cards.ps1`) and run this tool again, so only what is still missing is listed.

| Character | Cards | Sheets |
|---|---|---|
| Knight | 40 | 5 |
| Assassin | 47 | 6 |
| Shaman | 20 | 3 |
| Spellblade | 28 | 4 |
| Drunkard | 6 | 1 |
| Necromancer | 28 | 4 |

## Knight

### Sheet `knight-m01` (9 pictures, uncommon first)

```
Create ONE ILLUSTRATION SHEET of 9 separate card-art pictures for a card-battler game (like Slay the Spire), 2400 x 1800, no text.
The attached image (Valeria) is the STYLE ANCHOR: match its cartoon game-art rendering exactly (bold clean dark outlines, flat saturated colours, simple cel shading, crisp polished shapes). Do NOT copy her character; paint scenes and objects. Backgrounds are softer and less contrasty than the main subject so the subject pops.

LAYOUT (critical): a clean 3 x 3 grid of landscape 4:3 pictures (each about 760 x 570), separated by thin flat dark navy (#14181f) gutters, with NO frames, NO borders, NO captions, NO text, NO numbers. Every picture fills its own cell completely; nothing crosses a gutter. Each picture has ONE clear subject in the middle that reads at thumbnail size, a simple scene behind it, light from the upper left.

WORLD: Valeria, a blonde knight in blue-and-gold plate. A knight of the Gilded Order. No companions: Might, Barrier and a deck she burns down to a point. World: a gilded cathedral-castle: white marble, gold, royal blue, warm sunset light through stained glass.

THE PICTURES, in this exact order, left to right, top row first. Use the card name and its effect only to decide what to draw; never write the name:
1. "Intimidate" (skill): Apply 1 Exposed. Gain Might equal to the target's Exposed. Consume. Show a defensive or tactical moment, calm and clear.
2. "Juggler's Rhythm" (aura): Whenever you play an Attack: If this is your third Attack this turn: Add a copy of that card to your hand. Show a grand symbolic still-life: one iconic object or pose that stands for the idea.
3. "Mounting Fury" (attack): Deal 9 damage, plus all it has grown. Every copy of this card gains 5 damage for the rest of the fight. Show a dynamic strike caught mid-action.
4. "Numbing Rite" (aura): Whenever a card is consumed: Gain 3 Barrier. Show a grand symbolic still-life: one iconic object or pose that stands for the idea.
5. "Pact of Embers" (skill): Consume 1 card. Draw 2 cards. Show a defensive or tactical moment, calm and clear.
6. "Pile On" (attack): Deal 4 (+2 per Exposed on the target) damage. Show a dynamic strike caught mid-action.
7. "Plunder" (attack): Deal 6 damage. Draw cards until you draw a card that is not an Attack. Show a dynamic strike caught mid-action.
8. "Provoke" (skill): Gain 7 Barrier. Apply 1 Exposed. Show a defensive or tactical moment, calm and clear.
9. "Reckless Smite" (attack): Lose 2 HP. Deal 15 damage. Show a dynamic strike caught mid-action.

NEGATIVE: text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, UI, card frames, borders, watermark, logo, photorealism, gritty texture, nudity, characters facing away.

FILE: when the image is done, save it as a PNG file named exactly knight-m01.png and give me a download link to that file.
```
